correctness.rationale: For any incenter-centroid edge-incentric simplex, Hajja's exact facet-volume condition places every distinct reciprocal balloon radius among the roots of \(F(z)=(d-1)z^4-2Mz^3+Cz^2-K\). Four positive roots contradict the zero linear coefficient by Vieta. For the \(d=8\) construction, exact polynomial identities force the three proposed positive values to give one common \(Q_i\), and the exact inequality \(M^2-7N>0\) invokes Hajja's existence criterion. The packaged checker replays all nontrivial algebraic identities with rational arithmetic.
